    public static void Serialize(Cat obj, System.IO.Stream stream)
    {
        if (obj is null)
        {
            throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(obj));
        }
        global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Id));
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj.Name))
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, 0);
        }
        else
        {
            var nameStringByteCount = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(obj.Name);
            var nameStringTotalBytes = nameStringByteCount + sizeof(int);
            if (nameStringTotalBytes <= 256)
            {
                Span<byte> nameStringBuffer = stackalloc byte[nameStringTotalBytes];
                System.Buffers.Binary.BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(nameStringBuffer, nameStringByteCount);
                var nameStringActualBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(obj.Name, nameStringBuffer.Slice(sizeof(int)));
                stream.Write(nameStringBuffer.Slice(0, sizeof(int) + nameStringActualBytes));
            }
            else
            {
                var nameStringBufferRented = System.Buffers.ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(nameStringTotalBytes);
                try
                {
                    var nameStringBuffer = nameStringBufferRented.AsSpan(0, nameStringTotalBytes);
                    System.Buffers.Binary.BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(nameStringBuffer, nameStringByteCount);
                    var nameStringActualBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(obj.Name, nameStringBuffer.Slice(sizeof(int)));
                    stream.Write(nameStringBuffer.Slice(0, sizeof(int) + nameStringActualBytes));
                }
                finally
                {
                    System.Buffers.ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(nameStringBufferRented);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
